exercises.title: Put the Bootstrap setup steps in order
exercises.problemHtml:
Drag (or use ↑/↓) to put the steps in the correct order. These are the exact steps you type in the lab room at the start of a PE.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Put the Bootstrap setup steps in order — answer key

1. Order the steps to start a React + Bootstrap project with Vite.
   Answer: a) npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react  →  b) cd my-app then npm install  →  c) npm install bootstrap react-bootstrap  →  d) import 'bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css' in main.jsx  →  e) Use import { Button } from 'react-bootstrap' in a component  →  f) npm run dev and open the local URL
   Create → install → add Bootstrap → import CSS once → use components → run. / Tạo → cài → thêm Bootstrap → import CSS một lần → dùng component → chạy.

2. Order the Bootstrap 5 breakpoints from the smallest screen to the largest.
   Answer: a) xs (< 576px)  →  b) sm (≥ 576px)  →  d) md (≥ 768px)  →  c) lg (≥ 992px)  →  e) xl (≥ 1200px)  →  f) xxl (≥ 1400px)
   xs < sm 576 < md 768 < lg 992 < xl 1200 < xxl 1400. / xs < sm 576 < md 768 < lg 992 < xl 1200 < xxl 1400.

# Bootstrap setup check

Answer in the panel on the left (no code needed).

1. You installed react-bootstrap but buttons look plain. Why?
2. Where is the best place for import 'bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css'?
3. Which are TRUE about react-bootstrap? (choose all)
4. The exam room has no internet. Which way of adding Bootstrap still works?

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Bootstrap setup check — answer key

1. You installed react-bootstrap but buttons look plain. Why?
   Answer: b) The Bootstrap CSS file was never imported.
   react-bootstrap renders the markup; the styling comes from bootstrap.min.css which you import once. / react-bootstrap chỉ sinh markup; giao diện đến từ bootstrap.min.css bạn phải import một lần.

2. Where is the best place for import 'bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css'?
   Answer: b) Once, in the entry file (main.jsx / index.js) before your own CSS.
   Import global CSS once at the entry point, before your own styles so you can override Bootstrap. / Import CSS toàn cục một lần ở điểm vào, trước CSS của bạn để bạn ghi đè được Bootstrap.

3. Which are TRUE about react-bootstrap? (choose all)
   Answer: a) It replaces Bootstrap’s jQuery/JS with React components. + c) Props like variant become Bootstrap classes. + d) You can still use plain Bootstrap classes in className.
   react-bootstrap re-implements the behaviour in React and maps props to classes; it does not ship CSS. / react-bootstrap viết lại hành vi bằng React và đổi prop thành class; nó không kèm CSS.

4. The exam room has no internet. Which way of adding Bootstrap still works?
   Answer: b) npm package already in node_modules of the given project
   A CDN needs the network. The project template sent before the exam already contains the packages in node_modules. / CDN cần mạng. Dự án mẫu gửi trước kỳ thi đã có sẵn gói trong node_modules.
